title: 文章复盘 · 8题
meta: 2014 英语一 Part B (paragraph ordering) · 2026-10-25学习复盘 · 本篇问题 1 题 + 历史弱项 7 题 · 全部使用迁移语境

questions.target: what judges upheld vs legislative justification
questions.skill: 判断题干询问的是司法结论还是解释理由
questions.q: A court upheld municipal inspectors' limited role in checking flood barriers. In support, it cited a law inviting national and municipal teams to share inspection reports. What did the court uphold?
o: National lawmakers were required to lead each municipal inspection.
City inspectors could assist while complying with national rules.
Municipal teams gained the right to replace national flood standards.
National inspectors had to stop exchanging reports with city teams.

exp.trans: 法院认可市政检查员在防洪设施检查中的有限作用，并援引鼓励国家和地方机构共享检查报告的法律作为依据。问题问法院认可的结论，而不是法律提供的支持理由。
exp.structure: A court upheld是第一句核心司法结论；In support, it cited...是第二句介绍支持证据的结构。What did the court uphold要求回到第一句。
exp.other: uphold 维持、认可；municipal 市政的；barrier 防洪设施；cite 引用；inspection 检查；comply with 遵守。
exp.meaning: 法院认可地方机构在法律约束下协助检查；国会的协作规定只是理由。不能把原因中的立法机关错认成法院同意的具体事项。
exp.rest: 立法机关亲自检查不是结论；市政机构没有权力替换国家标准；原文支持共享报告，不能推成停止共享。

questions.skill: 按提问定位过程中的决定而非总选最后一步
questions.q: A technician noticed an unusual label on a food shipment and asked a supervisor whether it should be checked. The supervisor marked the shipment 'hold', stopping dispatch. A laboratory later found the contents safe, and the quality manager signed the release form. Which event directly stopped the shipment from leaving?
o: The technician's request for advice about the label.
The supervisor's decision to put the shipment on hold.
The laboratory's conclusion that the contents were safe.
The quality manager's signature on the release form.

exp.trans: 技术员发现一批食品的标签异常，询问主管是否应检查。主管将这批货标为暂扣，停止发运。实验室后来确认货物内容安全，质量经理签署了放行单。哪个事件直接阻止了货物运出？是主管作出的暂扣决定。
exp.structure: The technician + noticed ... and asked ...是发现和上报；whether it should be checked是询问内容，其中should be checked为被动谓语。The supervisor + marked + the shipment + hold，后接stopping dispatch说明结果。found the contents safe为find加宾语和形容词补语；signed the release form属于后来的放行阶段。
exp.other: shipment 一批货物；put on hold 暂停、暂扣；dispatch 发运；release form 放行单；contents 所装物品。
exp.meaning: 先确定题目问的是停止发运，而非最早发现异常、确认安全或最终放行。直接产生停运结果的是主管的暂扣决定。过程角色题必须按问题定位阶段，不能一概选最后的正式批准。
exp.rest: 技术员询问是否检查，是上报起点，文中实际停运由主管决定；实验室认定安全发生在之后，支持解除疑虑；经理签放行单允许后续运出，与停止运出方向相反。

questions.target: claim about enforcement power vs legal authority
questions.skill: 区分行政部门的主张与作者认可的结论
questions.q: An executive agency claims it can invalidate any otherwise lawful regional rule whenever that rule conflicts with the agency's enforcement priorities. What does the agency's claim amount to?
o: Regional governments can override national laws they oppose.
Its enforcement priorities can override lawful regional rules.
The legislature prohibited regional agencies from enforcing rules.
Regional rules remain valid despite different enforcement priorities.

exp.trans: 一个行政机构声称，只要某项原本合法的地区规则与该机构的执法优先事项冲突，它就可以使该规则失效。这相当于声称，该机构的执法权高于地区政府所拥有的权限。
exp.structure: claims后面是机构主张的内容；whenever引出触发条件；otherwise lawful表示该规则在其他方面原本合法。
exp.other: invalidate 使……失效；otherwise lawful 原本合法的；enforcement priorities 执法优先事项；outweigh 权重或重要性高于。
exp.meaning: 要区分被描述的主张与文章作者认可的结论。句子是在复述行政机构想要的权力范围，并不代表作者认为这种主张正确。
exp.rest: 地区推翻国家法律反转了主张中的权力方向；立法机关禁止地方执法没有文本依据；机构声称可使规则失效，并非承认优先事项不同时规则仍有效。

questions.q:
The plumber thanked the neighbour. He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour.
哪句合并正确？
o: The plumber thanked the neighbour from that he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom from he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from him.

exp.trans: 水管工感谢了那位借梯子给他的邻居。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour. → 用whom替代重复的the neighbour：the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from → 把from前置：the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder。外层主干是The plumber + thanked + the neighbour，后接修饰neighbour的定语从句。
exp.other: plumber 水管工；neighbour 邻居；ladder 梯子；borrow A from B 从B那里借来A。
exp.meaning: from不是临时猜出来的，来自原句borrow...from...；先行词是人，介词后用whom。
exp.rest: from that：关系代词that不能直接置于介词后。whom from he：介词前置时必须是from whom，不是whom from。from him：关系代词whom已经代替该人，再保留him造成重复。

questions.target: 原因 / 应对措施 / 后续结果
questions.q: After several small firms missed an application deadline, the council extended the next round by a week to give them another chance. Participation in that later round has not yet been measured. Which statement preserves the roles?
o: The extension caused firms to miss the earlier deadline.
Measured gains in later participation prompted the council's extension.
Missed deadlines prompted an extension; later effects are unmeasured.
The earlier deadline was a response to the council's later extension.

exp.trans: 几家小企业错过申请截止时间后，市政委员会将下一轮的期限延长一周，给它们再一次机会。后一轮的参与情况尚未统计。错过期限是延长期限这一应对措施的背景，措施对随后参与的影响仍未知。
exp.structure: after从句：several small firms + missed + an application deadline。主句：the council + extended + the next round，by a week表示延长量，to give them another chance说明目的。Participation + has not yet been measured是现在完成时被动谓语。
exp.other: firm 企业；application 申请；deadline 截止时间；participation 参与情况。
exp.meaning: 区分原先问题、事后应对和尚未观测的效果。不能让后来的措施成为较早失败的原因，也不能凭实施措施就宣称取得改善。
exp.rest: 后来的延期不能造成更早的错过期限；尚未测量的后续参与数据不能成为先前延期的依据；较早的规则也不是对较晚措施的回应。

questions.skill: 区分并行规则、直接冲突与领域排除
questions.q: A federal air-safety code exclusively regulates emergency signals. A city adopted a similar signal rule. Although the city's rule was not shown to contradict a specific clause, a court set it aside because the code already covered the entire field. Why?
o: The city rule was barred because national law already occupied the field.
The federal code was cancelled because the city's provisions ran parallel.
The court ordered the city to enforce its rule beside the national code.
The judges delayed a decision until the national agency reviewed its budget.

exp.trans: 一套联邦航空安全规范对紧急信号作了专属规定。某市采用了类似规则。尽管没有证明市级规则直接违反特定条文，法院仍因联邦规范已全面覆盖该领域而排除了市级规定。
exp.structure: Although引导让步：没有证明逐条直接矛盾；主句a court set it aside给出判决；because说明真正理由是整个领域已由上级规则全面规制。
exp.other: exclusively 专属地；signal 信号；contradict 与……相矛盾；set aside 废除、排除；occupy the field 通过全面规制排除下级立法。
exp.meaning: 并行或类似不等于相抵触；领域排除的判断依据是整个领域已由上级法律覆盖，不要求指出某条具体文字直接冲突。
exp.rest: 没有推翻联邦规范；法院没有命令城市同时执行两套规则；也没有推迟判决等待预算审查。

questions.q: An energy guide first explains that meter logs locate periods of high demand. A paragraph about equipment inspections follows. The next two paragraphs describe a bakery and a warehouse that combined logs with inspections. What is the role of the inspections paragraph?
o: It completes the methods that the later cases apply.
It summarizes the outcomes reported in the later cases.
It gives a third case after the bakery and warehouse.
It withdraws the claim that meter logs can be useful.

exp.trans: 能源指南先解释用电表日志定位高需求时段，再介绍设备检查；后面两个案例同时使用日志和检查。检查段是在补齐随后案例会应用的方法。
exp.structure: first、follows、next交代段落顺序；combined logs with inspections说明两个案例同时依赖前面两种方法，不是只应用第一段的方法。
exp.other: meter log 电表记录；equipment inspection 设备检查；high demand 高需求；apply 应用。
exp.meaning: 一个方法段结束，不代表下一段必须马上举例。要检查后面案例需要哪些方法说明，再分清并列方法与两则应用案例的层级。
exp.rest: 总结后文结果需要结果性内容，检查方法本身不能当作结果总结；它位于两案例前也不是第三案例；案例同时使用日志，并未撤回日志有用的判断。

questions.target: post=职位 / aspiration / 文本证据
questions.skill: 熟词生义 + 证据约束
questions.q: After five years as a sous-chef, Lena began applying for head-chef posts because she wanted to run a kitchen of her own. What is directly supported by the sentence?
o: She expected a higher salary.
She was pursuing a new career goal.
She disliked everyone in her current kitchen.
She had already been offered a head-chef job.

exp.trans: 做了五年副厨师长后，Lena开始申请主厨职位，因为她想独立管理一个厨房。句子直接支持：她正在追求新的职业目标。
exp.structure: 主句：Lena（主语）+ began applying（谓语）+ for head-chef posts。because从句给出原因：she wanted to run a kitchen of her own。原因明确指向职业角色和职责，而非薪酬。
exp.other: sous-chef 副厨师长；head-chef post 主厨职位；apply for 申请；run a kitchen 管理厨房。
exp.meaning: post在这里是职位；“想独立管理厨房”是职业抱负/目标。不能因为职位更高就擅自补出“工资更高”。
exp.rest: higher salary在现实中可能成立，但原句没有salary/pay等证据；disliked everyone完全无依据；began applying只表示开始申请，不等于已经拿到offer。

text4-agreement-target.skill: 区分法官认可的结论与国会提供的理由
text4-agreement-target.q: A court permits county officers to check residency status during limited enforcement encounters. It cites Congress's support for joint national-local enforcement. What did the judges agree on?
o: Congress must personally direct every local enforcement decision.
Local authorities may assist with enforcement within the limits set by law.
National officers must withhold all enforcement information from local teams.
Local authorities can disregard national rules when enforcing local policy.

exp.trans: 法院允许县级执法人员在有限的执法接触中核查居住身份，并引用国会支持国家与地方共同执法的立场。法官达成一致的是：地方当局可以在法律规定的范围内协助执法。
exp.structure: A court permits...直接陈述司法结论；It cites...引出支持这一结论的立法背景。题目问What did the judges agree on，因此应回答法院允许什么，而不是重复国会的理由。
exp.other: permit 允许；residency status 居住身份；joint 共同的；enforcement 执法；withhold information 不提供信息。
exp.meaning: 阅读题要区分结论和论据。国会鼓励共同执法，是法院认可地方执法角色的理由，不是题目所问的结论本身。
exp.rest: 国会亲自指挥每项地方执法决定过于绝对；原文鼓励信息共享而非要求扣留信息；地方参与执法并不意味着可以无视国家规则。

text4-agreement-target.target: what the judges agreed on vs why
text4-agreement-target.skill: 题干询问对象 + 结论与理由分层
text4-agreement-target.q: Judges agreed that county officers could verify residency status during certain enforcement encounters. The opinion explains that the national legislature had repeatedly encouraged joint national-local enforcement and information sharing. What did the judges agree on?
o: The national legislature had taken over every local enforcement decision.
Counties were independent of national law.
Local authorities had a legitimate role in enforcement within legal limits.
National officers were required to withhold information.

exp.trans: 法官们同意，县级执法人员在某些执法接触中可以核查居住身份。判决解释说，国家立法机关一直鼓励国家与地方共同执法和共享信息。法官们达成一致的是：地方当局在法律允许的范围内拥有正当的执法角色。
exp.structure: Judges agreed that...直接引出法官认可的结论；The opinion explains that...再引出支持这一结论的理由。不要把后一句的national legislature误当成题干询问的结论主体。
exp.other: verify 核实；enforcement 执法；legitimate 正当的、合法的；withhold information 扣留信息、不提供信息。
exp.meaning: 题干问what did the judges agree on，先找法院允许什么，再看立法机关的政策如何解释该决定。理由提到了国会，不代表答案就是国会介入。
exp.rest: 没有说立法机关接管所有地方执法；地方仍受国家法律约束；原文支持信息共享，而非要求联邦人员隐瞒信息。

text4-agreement-target.skill: 区分司法结论与立法背景
text4-agreement-target.q: A court allows city inspectors to check permit status while coordinating with national officers. The opinion cites a statute encouraging shared databases and joint inspections. Which statement is the court's conclusion rather than the supporting reason?
o: The legislature encouraged coordination between national and local officials.
Local inspectors may play a legitimate role within the enforcement system.
Officials are encouraged to share information.
National law no longer applies to local inspections.

exp.trans: 法院允许城市检查员在与国家执法人员协调时核查许可证状态。判决援引了一项鼓励共享数据库和联合检查的法律。法院的结论是：地方检查员可以在执法体系中发挥正当作用。
exp.structure: The court allows...陈述法院允许的行为；The opinion cites...介绍支撑理由的法律背景。问题要求找conclusion，因此应回到法院实际允许什么。
exp.other: coordinate 协调；permit status 许可证状态；cite 引用；supporting reason 支持理由。
exp.meaning: 文章中的立法背景、理由和司法结论承担不同功能。即使理由出现得更显眼，也不能把它当成题干询问的结论。
exp.rest: 鼓励协调和共享信息都是支持理由；原文并未取消国家法律对地方检查的约束。

process-stage-role.target: 个人估计 vs 集体验证
process-stage-role.skill: 区分主张起点和取得认可所需条件
process-stage-role.q: An analyst estimates that the city has room for 4,000 people in emergency shelters. Officials will use this figure for evacuation plans only after independent teams verify the counts and agree on a common estimate. What makes the figure suitable for official planning?
o: The analyst's personal familiarity with the shelters.
Verification and agreement across independent teams.
The public release of a large numerical estimate.
The analyst's decision to avoid revising the original number.

exp.trans: 一位分析员估计城市应急避难所可容纳4000人；只有独立团队核查数据并就统一估计达成一致，政府才会在疏散计划中采用这一数字。
exp.structure: An analyst + estimates + that从句提出最初主张；Officials + will use + this figure ... only after ...，only after指出主张转化为官方依据所需的条件。
exp.other: emergency shelter 应急避难所；evacuation 疏散；estimate 估计；verify 核验。
exp.meaning: 题干问的是让一项初步主张获得认可所需要的机制。个人估计是起点，独立团队核查与达成一致是条件；不能因为看到analyst就选个人经验。
exp.rest: 个人熟悉情况只能解释估计如何产生；数字公开和规模大都不能自动证明可靠；拒绝修订反而与核查机制相冲突。

process-stage-role.target: 单次发现 vs 跨来源确认
process-stage-role.skill: 过程终点与条件的角色识别
process-stage-role.q: A driver first reports cracks on a bridge, but the warning is not issued to the whole region until engineers compare photographs, inspect the structure, and confirm the hazard. What is required for the initial report to become an official warning?
o: A more vivid description from the first driver.
Agreement that the first driver deserves public credit.
Public enthusiasm for an alarming photograph.
Independent assessment and confirmation of the reported danger.

exp.trans: 司机最先报告桥面裂缝，但直到工程师比对照片、检查结构并确认危险，地区警报才正式发布。
exp.structure: A driver + reports + cracks引入起点；the warning + is not issued ... until engineers compare, inspect, and confirm，用not...until表示形成正式警报的必要过程。
exp.other: crack 裂缝；structure 结构；hazard 危险；issue a warning 发布警报。
exp.meaning: 个人首次报告不等于正式被认可；由多个步骤进行独立评估并确认，才使主张具有可推广的效力。注意题目问required而非who noticed it first。
exp.rest: 报告更生动不能替代核验；给报告人荣誉不是警报成立条件；公众情绪不能替代工程检查。

process-stage-role.skill: 区分结果核验、消息公开与实施授权
process-stage-role.q: A hospital trial finds that a scheduling tool reduces missed appointments. The methods panel accepts the results after checking the analysis, and a staff newsletter reports the trial. Routine use must nevertheless wait for the operations board to approve a staffing plan. Which event authorises the hospital to start using the tool routinely?
o: Acceptance of the trial analysis by the methods panel.
Publication of the trial results in the staff newsletter.
The operations board's approval of the staffing plan.
The trial team's observation of fewer missed appointments.

exp.trans: 一家医院的试验发现，一种预约安排工具减少了爽约。方法审核小组检查分析后认可了结果，员工通讯也报道了这项试验。不过，常规使用仍须等待运营委员会批准人员配置计划。哪个事件授权医院开始常规使用该工具？答案是人员配置计划获批。
exp.structure: A hospital trial + finds + that从句给出试验发现；The methods panel + accepts + the results说明核验阶段。Routine use + must wait + for the operations board to approve a staffing plan说明实施仍受另一项决定约束。nevertheless连接结果已获认可与尚不能常规实施的转折。
exp.other: scheduling tool 预约安排工具；miss an appointment 爽约；methods panel 方法审核小组；staffing plan 人员配置计划；authorise 授权。
exp.meaning: 题目问开始常规实施的授权条件。独立核查在本文确实发生，却只让研究结果获得认可，不能替代运营委员会的实施批准。不能把所有过程题都机械答成独立验证。
exp.rest: 审核小组认可的是试验分析，不是常规使用的授权；员工通讯负责传播消息，没有审批权；试验团队观察到效果是提出采用建议的证据起点，仍未满足文中保留的实施条件。

text4-executive-overreach.skill: 区分行政部门的权力主张与作者认可的结论
text4-executive-overreach.q: An executive agency says it can invalidate any otherwise lawful regional rule whenever the rule conflicts with its enforcement priorities. What does that claim imply?
o: It claims its enforcement power outweighs regional governments' authority.
Regional governments may override national laws whenever they disagree.
The legislature expressly banned all regional enforcement activity.
The agency accepts regional rules despite differences in enforcement priorities.

exp.trans: 一个行政机构声称，只要原本合法的地区规则与其执法优先事项冲突，它就可以使该规则失效。这相当于声称行政机构的执法权高于地区政府的权限。
exp.structure: An executive agency says that...引出机构的主张；whenever引出触发条件；otherwise lawful表示该规则在其他方面原本合法。
exp.other: executive agency 行政机构；invalidate 使……失效；otherwise lawful 原本合法的；enforcement priorities 执法优先事项；authority 权限。
exp.meaning: 题目问what does that claim imply，应概括机构声称自己拥有多大权限，而不是把这一主张误当成作者认可的法律结论。
exp.rest: 地区政府可以随意推翻国家法律是把权力方向反过来；立法机关明文禁止所有地区执法并未在句中出现；最后一项与机构声称可使冲突规则失效相反。

text4-executive-overreach.target: executive enforcement choice vs statutory local authority
text4-executive-overreach.skill: 行政不执行是否能取消地方依法获授的权力
text4-executive-overreach.q: A national agency declined to inspect licensed buses, then claimed towns could not carry out inspections that a statute authorized them to do. The court rejected the claim. What principle does its decision illustrate?
o: The agency may suspend towns' lawful inspections by choosing not to act.
The court rejected an attempt to block towns from exercising powers granted by law.
The towns were newly authorized to rewrite national transport standards.
The court found that national agencies alone may set all inspection dates.

exp.trans: 国家行政机构不愿检查已获许可的公交车，随后却声称法律已授权的市镇检查也不能执行。法院驳回该主张，说明行政机关自身选择不执法，不能自动取消地方依法获授的权限。
exp.structure: declined... then claimed...区分行政机关自身行为与扩张主张；a statute authorized them to do修饰inspections；The court rejected the claim给出司法回应。
exp.other: agency 行政机构；statute 成文法；authorize 授权；suspend 暂停；licensed bus 已获许可的公交车辆。
exp.meaning: 行政机关不执行某项政策与禁止地方执行是两个命题。这里法院限制的是行政部门把其执行偏好扩展成否定地方合法权限的企图。
exp.rest: 行政不作为并未赋予机构暂停合法地方执法的权力；法院未授权市镇重写国家标准；设定检查日期也不是法院本次驳回的争点。

text4-executive-overreach.skill: 作者立场 + do so 回指
text4-executive-overreach.q: A transport ministry says that because it does not want to carry out Parliament's rail-safety plan, local councils should not be allowed to enforce it either. The court rejects this claim. What is best supported?
o: The court checks an executive attempt to extend power over local councils.
Parliament alone must enforce every rail-safety rule across all regions.
The ministry has unlimited control over local councils and their rules.
Local councils may ignore national rail-safety laws whenever they choose to do so.

exp.trans: 法院正在制衡行政部门试图扩大自身对地方议会的权力。
exp.structure: because引出交通部不愿执行议会计划的原因；should not be allowed...either表示它还想阻止地方执行；The court rejects this claim给出司法回应。
exp.other: carry out 执行；executive 行政部门；council 地方议会；reject a claim 驳回一种主张。
exp.meaning: 行政部门不愿执行议会的计划，不等于它可以阻止地方在法律允许范围内执行。法院驳回这种主张，体现对行政权的制衡。
exp.rest: 原文没有说所有铁路安全规则只能由议会执行；交通部并没有无限控制权；法院驳回行政部门的主张也不意味着地方可以无视所有国家法律。

relative.q:
The archive contains several letters. The historian based her argument on those letters.
最自然的合并是：
o: The archive contains several letters on which the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which on the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters on that the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which the historian based her argument on them.

diag.1: 介词 on 应放在关系代词 which 前，不能写 which on the historian...
diag.2: 介词后不能用关系代词 that；应使用 which。
diag.3: which 已经代替 those letters，后面再用 them 造成重复。

exp.trans: 这个档案馆收藏着几封信，历史学家正是依据这些信件提出了她的论证。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：The historian based her argument on those letters. → those letters 变成先行词 several letters，并用 which 代替：the letters which the historian based her argument on → 正式写法把介词前置：the letters on which the historian based her argument。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；historian 历史学家；base A on B 以B为依据建立A；argument 论证/观点。
exp.meaning: 介词 + which 用于物；介词来自原简单句中的搭配 base A on B。
exp.rest: 介词前置的正确句是 “letters on which ...”；把 which 放在 on 前、把 that 放在介词后，或在 which 后再保留 them，都会造成词序或关系词重复问题。

causal-role-direction.target: attribute A to B / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: A trial attributed a drop in workshop dust to the installation of a new air filter. Which paraphrase preserves the reported cause and effect?
o: The decrease in dust made the workshop install a new filter.
Installing the filter helped reduce the amount of dust in the workshop.
Dust in the workshop improved the filter's performance.
The trial proved that every type of pollution had disappeared.

exp.trans: 一项试验把车间粉尘的减少归因于安装了新的空气过滤器。准确改写应保留“安装过滤器 → 粉尘减少”的因果方向。
exp.structure: A trial（主语）+ attributed（谓语）+ a drop in workshop dust（宾语/结果）+ to the installation of a new air filter（原因）。attribute A to B中A是被解释的结果，B是原因；名词化的installation保留install the filter这一动作。
exp.other: trial 试验；workshop 车间；dust 粉尘；installation 安装；air filter 空气过滤器。
exp.meaning: 不要把先出现的名词误当成原因。attribute A to B的方向是B导致A，而不是A导致B。
exp.rest: The decrease in dust made...把结果倒置为安装的原因；Dust improved the filter's performance交换了受影响对象并添加无据效果；every type of pollution把粉尘减少扩大为所有污染消失。

causal-role-direction.target: 施事与受事 / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: The gardeners shaded the seedlings during the hottest hours. As a result, fewer seedlings dried out. Which statement keeps the cause and the affected object in the right roles?
o: Healthier seedlings prompted the gardeners to provide shade.
The gardeners' shade reduced heat exposure for the seedlings.
The seedlings sheltered the gardeners from the hottest sun.
The drying seedlings caused a fall in the surrounding heat.

exp.trans: 园丁在最热的几小时给幼苗遮阴，因此干枯的幼苗变少了。正确改写是：园丁提供的遮阴减少了幼苗暴露在高温中的程度。
exp.structure: 第一句：The gardeners（施事/主语）+ shaded（谓语）+ the seedlings（受事/宾语）。第二句：fewer seedlings（主语）+ dried out（谓语）。As a result明确把遮阴和干枯减少连接为原因与结果。
exp.other: gardener 园丁；shade 给……遮阴；seedling 幼苗；dry out 干枯；exposure 暴露。
exp.meaning: 先标明谁采取动作、谁受影响，再核对因果方向。gardener → shade → seedlings dry out less，不能交换施事与受事。
exp.rest: 把幼苗更健康当成遮阳的先前原因是因果倒置；幼苗保护园丁交换了施事与受益者；干枯导致环境降温既反转因果，又偷换了暴露量与环境温度。

causal-role-direction.target: 因果角色 / 作用方向
causal-role-direction.q: Trust in the complaints system was weakened by delays in acknowledging reports. Fewer residents subsequently used it. Which chain matches the account?
o: Lower use caused the earlier delays, which then improved trust.
Delays weakened trust; reduced use followed that loss of trust.
Residents’ increased trust made acknowledgement take longer.
Fewer reports showed that complaints had been resolved more quickly.

exp.trans: 投诉系统迟迟不确认收到报告，削弱了人们对它的信任。随后使用它的居民减少了。符合叙述的链条是：确认延迟削弱信任，使用减少随后发生。
exp.structure: Trust是主语；was weakened是被动谓语；by delays标明导致信任下降的因素。第二句Fewer residents是主语，used是谓语，it指投诉系统。subsequently给出时间方向。
exp.other: complaints system 投诉系统；acknowledge reports 确认收到报告；delay 延迟；subsequently 随后。
exp.meaning: 被动句的语法主语是受到影响的信任，不是施加影响的延迟。第二步是后续使用减少，不能倒转为原先延迟的起因。文本是对该链条的叙述，并未报告受控实验。
exp.rest: Lower use caused the earlier delays把后续使用减少倒置为较早事件的原因，且improved trust与weakened相反；increased trust同时交换方向和变化趋势；resolved more quickly把使用量下降替换成解决速度提升，原文没有处理速度数据。

causal-role-direction.target: causal direction / known vs unknown outcome
causal-role-direction.skill: 区分已知原因、措施与尚未验证的后续结果
causal-role-direction.q: A grant committee extended an application deadline after several applicants missed it. The report says the effect on later participation has not been measured. Which summary is justified?
o: The missed deadline prompted an extension; later participation effects remain unmeasured.
Later participation figures prompted the committee to extend the earlier deadline.
The extension caused applicants to miss a deadline that had already passed.
Officials changed the deadline only after a separate review showed participation had fallen.

exp.trans: 几名申请者错过截止日期后，拨款委员会延长了申请期限。报告说，尚未测量这一调整对后续参与情况的影响。最准确的概括是：错过截止日期促成了延期，但延期对后续参与的影响仍未知。
exp.structure: extended是主句谓语；after several applicants missed it交代延期的时间背景和触发情境；the effect...has not been measured明确限制了对后续结果的推断。
exp.other: grant committee 拨款委员会；application deadline 申请截止日期；participation 参与；measure 测量、评估。
exp.meaning: 必须区分已知的原因与尚未测量的后果。原文支持错过期限后发生延期，但不支持断言延期一定提高或降低后续参与。
exp.rest: 后续参与数据没有促成前面的延期；延期不可能导致申请者错过一个已经过去的截止日期；原文没有提到另一次审查或参与人数下降。

text4-federal-state-boundary.target: parallel rule / occupied the field / field pre-emption
text4-federal-state-boundary.skill: 区分并行规则、直接冲突与领域排除
text4-federal-state-boundary.q: A national safety code covers the whole field of product labelling. A state adds a parallel rule, and a court invalidates it because the code has “occupied the field.” Which explanation best fits the ruling?
o: The rule failed because another state's policy directly contradicted it.
The rule was pre-empted because national law already covered the field.
The rule was approved because parallel rules can never conflict.
The court delayed the case until lawmakers revised the enforcement budget.

exp.trans: 国家安全规范全面覆盖了产品标签领域。某州又增加了一项并行规定，法院因为国家规范已经“占据了该领域”而判定州规定无效。最合适的解释是：国家法律已全面规制该领域，因此州规定被排除。
exp.structure: A national safety code covers the whole field；第二句由and连接州增加规定与法院判定无效的动作；because从句给出判决理由。occupied the field是法律语境中的领域排除概念。
exp.other: product labelling 产品标签；invalidate 判定无效；pre-empt 排除州层面的规制；enforcement budget 执法预算。
exp.meaning: parallel表示并行，不等于contradict。即使没有逐条直接冲突，若国家立法已经全面覆盖该领域，州规定仍可能被排除。
exp.rest: 另一州的政策不是本案依据；parallel rules can never conflict把并行绝对化；法院已经作出无效判决，并非等待预算调整。

text4-federal-state-boundary.target: knock out / contested provisions / field preemption
text4-federal-state-boundary.skill: 法律词组放回语境 + 联邦与州权限边界
text4-federal-state-boundary.q: A legal report says the court 'knocked out' three contested provisions in a state's licensing plan. The judgment adds that the national legislature had already 'occupied the field,' although the state rules did not directly contradict one specific national clause. Which paraphrase best captures the reasoning?
o: The court delayed the dispute because the rules were too complicated.
The court struck down the rules because national law covered this field.
The court approved the rules as harmless additions to national policy.
The court found that the state had contradicted two other states' own laws.

exp.trans: 法院推翻了州计划中的争议条款，因为国家立法已经全面覆盖该领域。
exp.structure: knocked out表示推翻；contested provisions是有争议的条款；although引导让步，说明即使没有直接违反某一条具体规定，也可能因为occupied the field而被排除。
exp.other: knock out 推翻、使无效；contested 有争议的；provision 法律条款；occupy the field 全面覆盖某一立法领域。
exp.meaning: 判决的理由不是其他州的政策，也不是条款太复杂，而是国家立法已经全面规制该领域。parallel不自动等于contradict。
exp.rest: 延期审理与法院已经推翻条款不符；批准条款与invalidates相反；原文没有说州政策违反了另外两个州的法律。

text4-federal-state-boundary.skill: 区分并行规定、直接冲突与领域排除
text4-federal-state-boundary.q: A national law creates a comprehensive safety-label system for medical devices. A state adds a parallel labelling rule. A court invalidates the state provision because the national law has occupied the field. Which inference is strongest?
o: Resemblance to national rules is enough to void a state rule.
National coverage can bar a state rule without a direct clash.
The state rule conflicted with a neighbouring state's law.
The court found the national safety-label law lacked authority.

exp.trans: 国家法律建立了全面的医疗器械安全标签制度。某州又增加了一项并行的标签规定。法院因为国家法律已经全面覆盖该领域而判定州规定无效。最有力的推断是：即使没有直接矛盾，州规定也可能因领域排除而不能成立。
exp.structure: creates与adds分别描述国家和州制定规则；because引出法院判决的原因。because the national law has occupied the field不是说两项规则必须逐字冲突，而是说明该领域已由国家立法全面规制。
exp.other: comprehensive 全面的；labelling 标签规定；invalidate 判定无效；pre-empt 排除与之不相容的州层面规制。
exp.meaning: parallel只表示并行或相应，并不自动等于contradict。判断权限问题时，要区分直接冲突与国家立法已占据整个领域这两种理由。
exp.rest: 类似不自动等于无效，关键是国家立法已全面覆盖该领域；判决没有依据邻州法律；法院承认国家规范的权威，并未否定它。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
段落甲结尾：Not surprisingly, nearly half of the applicants withdraw before the final interview.
下面哪个段首与它的衔接最强？
o: Equally unsurprisingly, few of the remaining applicants receive an offer.
By contrast, the final interviews take place in the company's new building.
For example, managers from several departments attend the final interview.
In conclusion, a final interview is unnecessary for applicants who remain.

exp.trans: 甲段说“不出所料，近一半申请者在终面前退出”。最强衔接是：“同样不足为奇的是，留下的人中也只有很少一部分收到录用。”
exp.structure: Not surprisingly先给出一个“并不意外”的结果；Equally unsurprisingly显式要求前面已经有一个同类判断，再补第二个并列结果。两个副词短语构成明显篇章钩子。
exp.other: withdraw 退出；final interview 终面；a small share 少部分；receive an offer 获得录用。
exp.meaning: Equally / similarly / also 等段首词常要求前文存在可并列对象。排序题中这种平行措辞比泛泛的主题相似更可靠。
exp.rest: 换到面试地点没有形成真正对立；经理参会不是申请者退出的例子；也不能从退出比例推出剩余申请者无需面试。平行标记与申请者筛选链共同支持承接。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
一篇先分析家电过早报废、后提出改进办法的文章，有一候选段写道：After examining the figures, Dr Patel sums up her proposal: shared repair services could help residents keep appliances longer. 段末又说：Whether enough households will join, however, remains an open question.
这一段最适合放在哪里？
o: 全文开头，用来首次介绍Dr Patel
问题分析展开之前
全文结尾附近，作为总结和改革建议
只能放在具体数据段之前

exp.trans: 考察数据后，Patel博士总结自己的建议：共享维修服务或许能让居民更长久地使用电器。但是否有足够多家庭参与，仍是未决问题。这段最适合放在结尾附近。
exp.structure: After examining the figures回看前文数据；Dr Patel + sums up + her proposal明确给出总结动作。末句Whether...will join作主语，remains...为谓语部分，以未决问题收束。
exp.other: sum up 总结；shared repair service 共享维修服务；appliance 家电；household 家庭；open question 未决问题。
exp.meaning: 总结建议与回顾数据、开放结尾合起来支持尾段位置；单独出现concludes或sum up并不能证明必为全文最后一段。
exp.rest: 首次介绍人物不能解释已分析过数据；在问题分析前放总结建议与给定结构不合；“只能放在数据段之前”更与After examining the figures相反。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 段尾问题 / 原因解释
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前段：The theatre sold every seat at the advertised price. Yet the deposits in its bank account were smaller than the value of tickets sold. The manager began tracing the gap between bookings and payments.
哪个后段最能推进这一问题？
o: Audience surveys ranked music above scenery when asking about favourite parts of the performance.
The booking agency deducted its service fees before forwarding the remaining money to the theatre.
The theatre had used the same stage for years, although its audience changed with each production.
Rehearsals ended later than planned, so actors sometimes travelled home together.

exp.trans: 剧院按宣传价卖出了所有座位，但银行入账小于售票总额。经理追查订票与收到款项之间的差额。订票代理转款之前先扣除服务费，最直接解释这个差额。
exp.structure: The theatre + sold + every seat。deposits + were smaller than + the value of tickets sold是金额比较。正确后段中The booking agency + deducted + service fees；before forwarding说明扣款发生在剧院收到钱之前。
exp.other: deposit 入账款；advertised price 宣传价格；deduct 扣除；forward money 转款。
exp.meaning: 没有One reason或Equally等显眼连接词，也能由段尾的收款差额锁定后段的扣费机制。这是问题→原因，不是看见theatre或audience就接同主题段。证据来自金额和交易阶段，不是一个单词。
exp.rest: Audience surveys解释演出偏好，未说明钱款差额；same stage介绍场地历史，未接收款链；rehearsals和共同回家是演出活动信息，不解释代理转款前少了什么。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 表面便利 vs 参与不足
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 讽刺语气 + 对比过渡
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前文：The online course called itself interactive, but students could do little more than click Next after each recorded lecture. The easiest part was operating the screen; the hardest was staying awake.
【空缺】
后文：What would genuine participation require? Students could challenge arguments and revise one another's work.
哪句最适合？
o: The simple controls already give learners an active role in shaping the course.
A redesign could replace passive viewing with a real role in shaping discussion.
Recorded lectures also let learners choose when to watch the same presentation.
Adding subtitles would make the recorded lectures easier for learners to follow.

exp.trans: 前文用带讽刺性的说法指出所谓互动课仍只让学生被动点下一页；正确句转向让学生真正贡献观点的另一种课程；后文追问真正参与需要什么。
exp.structure: but建立宣称interactive与实际只能click Next的矛盾；the hardest was staying awake暗示被动乏味。正确句用replace passive viewing with a real role in shaping discussion提出另一模式，后文再具体说明质疑论点与互相修改。
exp.other: interactive 互动的；lecture 讲座/课；challenge an argument 质疑论点；revise 修订。
exp.meaning: 看到操作很简单，不能自动判为作者赞扬。应结合转折、夸张和后文提问判断作者真正评价：被动消费不足，主动参与才是重点。
exp.rest: 操作简单不等于能参与建构讨论；自选观看时间和字幕提升观看便利，却没有补上后文要求的质疑论点、互评修改等主动参与。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 单向展示→反向参与→后文设问
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前文：At the old science museum, visitors watched a machine demonstrate each experiment. The most demanding thing they could do was press the Start button.
【空缺】
后文：What counts as taking part in an experiment? Visitors must be able to change a variable and compare the results.
哪一句最适合？
o: Repairs to the building could give the passive displays a more attractive setting.
Simpler controls could help more visitors watch the same machine demonstrations.
More detailed labels could explain the inventors behind the museum's machines.
A redesign could replace watching demonstrations with carrying out one's own tests.

exp.trans: 旧科技馆由机器单向演示，观众几乎只能按开始按钮。正确句引出新展览如何扭转这种被动观看，让观众亲自试验；后文再问什么才是真正参与实验。
exp.structure: 前文visitors watched与could do ... press Start显示参与程度低；正确句replace watching demonstrations with carrying out one’s own tests对比观看与亲自实验，后文change a variable和compare the results说明这种参与如何实现。
exp.other: demanding 费力的；demonstration 演示；variable 变量；carry out a test 进行试验。
exp.meaning: 最有力的证据是双向：反转被动的安排承接前文，主动测试又引出后文讨论。‘最难任务只是按按钮’在语境中揭示参与不足，不是对设备的夸赞。
exp.rest: 场馆外观、观看操作和发明者标签仍把参观者放在观看或接收信息的位置；只有亲自测试自然引出后文改变变量、比较结果的参与标准。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: new funding mechanism / That consequence / topical two-group distractor
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 制度改革先说明执行机制，再由That引出合作结果
paragraph-order-discourse.q: A public library will stop funding children's and adult literacy programs through entirely separate budgets. Officials stress that the reform should strengthen both. [BLANK] That should produce more projects serving whole families, rather than two unrelated groups. Which fits?
o: The new process will require both programs to design projects together.
Regional libraries have published more reports about literacy this year.
Some employees focus on adult readers, while others teach children.
The board will create separate committees for each age group.

exp.trans: 图书馆计划取消儿童和成人识字项目完全分立的预算。改革目标是同时加强两者。随后要解释两项目如何一起设计方案，这才能使服务整个家庭的合作项目增加。
exp.structure: That回指空格中描述的具体做法；new process...design projects together才会自然导致projects serving whole families。两个研究群体的存在是话题背景，不是合作机制。
exp.other: literacy 读写能力；entirely separate 完全分开的；joint project 联合项目；committee 委员会。
exp.meaning: topic match≠discourse link：后句That should produce...是结果句，前句需要明确的行动或机制。如果只描述两个群体，读起来相关却没有形成因果链。
exp.rest: 发表报告不一定促进合作；成人/儿童分工只描述现状；继续成立独立委员会甚至背离整合改革的目标。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: policy integration / mechanism / This change consequence
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 空前改革目标与空后合作效果需要中间实施步骤
paragraph-order-discourse.q: A museum plans to replace isolated conservation and education grants with a shared application process. Its directors say neither department will lose support. [BLANK] This change could generate exhibitions linking research and visitor experience. Which fits?
o: The museum has recently seen a sharp increase in visitor attendance.
Staff will evaluate proposals jointly and choose teams to collaborate.
The departments have long published very different research reports.
The museum will divide each grant into two fixed independent parts.

exp.trans: 博物馆将把保护和教育研究的独立资助改成联合申请。管理层说两部门都不会失去支持。空格要解释联合评审并选择合作团队，才能顺接‘这一变化会产生连接研究与观众体验的展览’。
exp.structure: 空格前提供改革背景和意图；This change could generate...给出预期效果。中间需要能产生该效果的具体协作措施，而非笼统主题描述。
exp.other: conservation 保护、文物修复；grant 资助；jointly 联合地；exhibition 展览。
exp.meaning: 要核实桥接是否构成‘政策→机制→结果’链条，不能因选项也谈博物馆或部门就草率接受。
exp.rest: 游客增加和以往报告差异只是主题信息；再把资金硬分成两部分反而违背联合申请改革。
